notes.title: Launching a Demo soon and features we're working on!
notes.content:
Hi Quatros Noir fans!

We've released a new Quatros Noir video. What are your thoughts on it?
[previewyoutube=eYYAbcW9MRo;full][/previewyoutube]

On top of that, we're launching a Demo in late February. Want more info? Join [url=https://discord.com/invite/5Fb9gKjAeQ]our Discord[/url], and become part of our new community.

What's in the works:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974414/2878d9629e60a65f58ba507a7f48d63cc7a73b76.png[/img] User experience, including UI, achievements, game feel
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974414/2878d9629e60a65f58ba507a7f48d63cc7a73b76.png[/img] Creating awesome music tracks to set the mood for every mode
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974414/2878d9629e60a65f58ba507a7f48d63cc7a73b76.png[/img] Expanding the game to a full 27 modes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44974414/babca1dd303fceff6821a46556e44f0bbe9af5ea.gif[/img]
These are our top priorities, but if there’s something you’d love to see in the game, let us know. If it fits, we’ll do our best to make it happen (or at least add it to our backlog).

See you in the leaderboards,
Abthoclo
